lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo gurasikh gur sevade se pu(n)n paraanee ||
lines.translation: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who serve the Guru, are the most blessed beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanee ||10||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them; He is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sakhee saheleeaa se aap har bhaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is pleased with the Gurmukhs, the fellowship of the companions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har daragah painaaeeaa har aap gal laaeeaa ||11||
lines.translation: In the Lord's Court, they are given robes of honor, and the Lord Himself hugs them close in His embrace. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaide tin darasan deejai ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲਦੇ ਧੂੜਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham tin ke charan pakhaalade dhooR ghol ghol peejai ||12||
lines.translation: I wash their feet, and drink in the dust of their feet, dissolved in the wash water. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਤੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੀੜੀਆ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paan supaaree khaateeaa mukh beeReeaa laaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Those who eat betel nuts and betel leaf and smoke intoxicants,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har kade na chetio jam pakaR chalaaeeaa ||13||
lines.translation: but do not contemplate the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death will seize them and take them away. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har naamaa har chetiaa hiradai ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: tin jam neR na aavaee gurasikh gur piaare ||14||
lines.translation: And keep Him enshrined in their hearts. The Guru's Sikhs are the Guru's Beloveds. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai koee guramukh jaanai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is a treasure, known only to the few Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin satigur bhetiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanai ||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru, enjoy peace and pleasure. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daataa aakheeai tus kare pasaao ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is called the Giver; in His Mercy, He grants His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਨਾਓ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: hau gur vitahu sad vaariaa jin ditaRaa naao ||16||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has blessed me with the Lord's Name. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai har dei sanehaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, very blessed is the Guru, who brings the Lord's message.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: hau vekh vekh guroo vigasiaa gur satigur dehaa ||17||
lines.translation: I gaze upon the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru embodied, and I blossom forth in bliss. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur rasanaa a(n)mrit boladee har naam suhaavee ||
lines.translation: The Guru's tongue recites Words of Ambrosial Nectar; He is adorned with the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਵੀ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: jin sun sikhaa gur ma(n)niaa tinaa bhukh sabh jaavee ||18||
lines.translation: Those Sikhs who hear and obey the Guru - all their desires depart. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa maarag aakheeai kahu kit bidh jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Some speak of the Lord's Path; tell me, how can I walk on it?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: har har teraa naam hai har kharach lai jaaeeai ||19||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Name is my supplies; I will take it with me and set out. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin guramukh har aaraadhiaa se saah vad daane ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord, are wealthy and very wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: hau satigur kau sad vaariaa gur bachan samaane ||20||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru; I am absorbed in the Words of the Guru's Teachings. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too thaakur too saahibo toohai meraa meeraa ||
lines.translation: You are the Master, my Lord and Master; You are my Ruler and King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bhaavai teree ba(n)dagee too gunee gaheeraa ||21||
lines.translation: If it is pleasing to Your Will, then I worship and serve You; You are the treasure of virtue. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape har ik ra(n)g hai aape bahu ra(n)gee ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is absolute; He is The One and Only; but He Himself is also manifested in many forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੀ ॥੨੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee gal cha(n)gee ||22||2||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak, that alone is good. ||22||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 9 kaaphee ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Ninth Mehl, Kaafee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਨਾ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਚੇਤ ਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨਿ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chetanaa hai tau chet lai nis din mai praanee ||
lines.translation: If you are conscious, then be conscious of Him night and day, O mortal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੂਟੈ ਘਟ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhin chhin audh bihaat hai phootai ghat jiu paanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Each and every moment, your life is passing away, like water from a cracked pitcher. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun kaahi na gaavahee moorakh agiaanaa ||
lines.translation: Why do you not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you ignorant fool?

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਨਹਿ ਮਰਨੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothai laalach laag kai nahi maran pachhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: You are attached to false greed, and you do not even consider death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajahoo kachh bigario nahee jo prabh gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Even now, no harm has been done, if you will only sing God's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tih bhajan te nirabhai pad paavai ||2||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, by meditating and vibrating upon Him, you shall obtain the state of fearlessness. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਾਫਲ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaag lehu re manaa jaag lehu kahaa gaaphal soiaa ||
lines.translation: Wake up, O mind! Wake up! Why are you sleeping unaware?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tan upajiaa sa(n)g hee so bhee sa(n)g na hoiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧ ਜਨ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dh jan hit jaa siu keenaa ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, children and relatives whom you love,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਜਬ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu chhootio jab deh te daar agan mai deenaa ||1||
lines.translation: will throw your body into the fire, when your soul departs from it. ||1||
